description: This file defines a React functional component named Sidebar, which provides a navigation menu for the Hostel Management frontend application. It imports React, React Router's NavLink, and a CSS stylesheet to render a sidebar with links to various sections like Dashboard, Rooms, Students, Payments, Attendance, Reports, and Profile.
